name: efficient-claude-harness
description: A delegation harness for Claude Code: coding lanes, a code finder, a browser QA agent, a claim observer and edit-routing hooks.

plugins.name: ech
plugins.description: Agents that keep the main conversation small: ai-coder lanes (Cursor Composer, a delegation service), code-explorer, browser-qa, task-reviewer, claim-sentinel, plus warn-only routing hooks.

plugins.name: ech-coder
plugins.description: Coding lanes alone: ai-coder (Cursor Composer), ai-coder-high (delegation service), composer-merger, the route-gate edit hook and the delegation skill and command.

plugins.name: ech-pre-postmortem
plugins.description: The pre-post-mortem risk ritual: an Opus agent and a slash command.

plugins.name: ech-claim-check
plugins.description: A Haiku turn-end check that flags success or count claims made without a ground-truth check, with an optional claim-sentinel observer.

plugins.name: ech-errand
plugins.description: The errand router hook (warn, or enforce per project) plus the Haiku code-explorer agent.

plugins.name: ech-codex-review
plugins.description: Read-only cross-model review through Codex: sol-reviewer, OpenAI diff and plan reviewers, Astra, and a Codex-first PR review skill.

plugins.name: ech-mailbox
plugins.description: Holds peer-session messages until you ask, with an hourly digest and a /mailbox command. Off by default.

plugins.name: ech-context
plugins.description: Session-size hint and compact-guard hooks for long sessions.

plugins.name: ech-eli5
plugins.description: The ELI5 one-card output style and the card-guard Stop hook.
